generators.carrier: U(1) phases; U_p = U_12 * U_23 * U_34^-1 * U_41^-1 (oriented product)

relations.statement: Under U_ij -> exp(i a_i) U_ij exp(-i a_j), the oriented plaquette product U_p is unchanged, since site phases cancel around a closed loop
relations.hypotheses: plaquette is a closed oriented loop; link orientation reversal gives conjugate

relations.statement: For |U_p|=1, Re U_p <= 1, so 1 - Re U_p >= 0

lemmas.statement: The Wilson action S = beta_g sum_p (1 - Re U_p) is invariant under local U(1) gauge transformations
For beta_g >= 0, S >= 0, as a sum of nonnegative terms

near_misses.claim: Nonnegativity of S holds for any real beta_g
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The sign of beta_g matters: for beta_g < 0 the action is nonpositive, so nonnegativity requires beta_g >= 0 (an implicit hypothesis in the target)

near_misses.claim: An open path product of links is gauge invariant
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Endpoint phases exp(i a_i) and exp(-i a_j) do not cancel for an open path; only closed loops are invariant
